claim.scope: JSON timeline compilation and terminal completed-file MP4 export only; connected model generation is unimplemented.
claim.decay_trigger: Refresh on scoped source, upstream revision/prompt parser/temporal ratio/geometry/output-range changes, Python/NumPy/FFmpeg changes or evidence loss.

contract.alignment: Round exact requested time up; report both requested and effective frames/times. Reject collisions.
contract.mp4_input: Completed postprocessed display-range B1C3THW little-endian F32 file, not raw decoder pixels.

checks.ffmpeg_roundtrip: Observed successful 4-frame 16x16 output with ffprobe frame-count/geometry/rate checks.

upstream.loader_execution: Original _load_from_json and pure helpers AST-extracted from pinned source; no-op logger, standard-library dependencies. Full inference module/Torch not imported.
upstream.cases: Two exact sample prompts and one single-prompt nondefault640x1024 project; prompt counts match max_segments; no JSON boundaries; explicit overrides preserved.

adversary.provenance: Correlated same-lineage source review and observed CPU tests; not independent video-generation qualification.
closed_attacks: Geometry override explicitly emits [height,width] rather than descriptive-only dimensions.
Reserved upstream ||| separator rejected before loader joins/splits prompts.
Hy display range separated from raw decoder range and existing Wan default.
Compiler and exporter publish without overwriting existing files.

limitations: No connected native timeline executor, full generation, generated-scene quality or prompt-adherence test.
No arbitrary subframe control, resumable generation, camera trajectory or image/video-conditioning feature.
Exact-decimal requested-frame reporting does not reproduce binary-float timestamp parsing at arbitrarily close boundaries; explicit integer boundaries are the execution contract.
Terminal FFmpeg file encoding is CPU/file handling after completed model output, not GPU neural inference.
rollback: Omit the new Hy-Nomas tools; existing Wan callers retain default normalization.
next_signal: Connect the qualified native pipeline to explicit segment boundaries and terminal display postprocessing/export, then measure adherence, peak memory and seconds per video second.
